body:
Thanks for the bug report.

The issue likely comes from the [HitsPerPage](https://github.com/algolia/vue-instantsearch/blob/2a21b5226908f1f71c9ac28372de56d01eda813d/src/components/HitsPerPage.vue#L16-L21) component that doesn't pre-select the current refinement, as opposed to the [SortBy](https://github.com/algolia/vue-instantsearch/blob/2a21b5226908f1f71c9ac28372de56d01eda813d/src/components/SortBy.vue#L21) component.
